articles.title: BIHARI JALWA IN JAPAN: HOW IITIAN ABHISHEK ANAND MADE IT TO JAPAN’S CRICKET TEAM| BEYOND BORDERS
articles.description: From Rohtas in Bihar to IIT Kanpur - and then to Japan’s national cricket team.Abhishek Anand moved to Japan for a job, but carried his love for cricket with him.He found a cricket club, caught the attention of Japan’s selectors and became a Japan international.Now, as India plays Japan, his two worlds come together — with a special Bihar connection too.On Beyond Borders, Ananya Dasgupta brings you the story of cricket, ambition, migration and finding a new home without forgetting the old one.
